title: National Book Award Finalist May Be Ineligible for the Prize
summary: The writer Abdelrahman ElGendy was blocked from visiting the United States to attend this year’s National Book Awards ceremony. Though his memoir is a finalist for the nonfiction award, it appears not to qualify.
